warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.morphology.closing (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/morphology/gray.py:364): fixed neighborhoods, connectivity and level comparisons determine selected pixel values and component structure; arbitrary component names are normalized while changes to the physical masks or hierarchy remain detectable; skimage.color.hsv2rgb (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/color/colorconv.py:350): the pinned color convention fixes channel order, matrix coefficients, offsets and nonlinear gamma or polar conversions; arithmetic reassociation can change rounding but a channel swap or resolved gain error changes the measured color; skimage.color.rgb2hsv (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/color/colorconv.py:260): the pinned color convention fixes channel order, matrix coefficients, offsets and nonlinear gamma or polar conversions; arithmetic reassociation can change rounding but a channel swap or resolved gain error changes the measured color. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 17 (skimage.color.hsv2rgb); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The source-linked bounds remain proposals until the human reviews the measured calibration and accepts their scientific scope.
